title: Cashew Stew with a Twist
description: A hearty stew with a nutty twist, featuring australian cashews and a rich flavor profile.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrots and potatoes, and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, salt, and pepper.
Pour in beef broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add cashews and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
